findings.title: Retry retries a possibly non-idempotent request
findings.detail: Retry retries every failure the same way, including one where send may have already taken effect before returning an error, such as a call that creates a record; the loop should skip retrying that case.
findings.risk_rationale: Retrying a request that already succeeded server-side can duplicate its effect.

summary: Retry should not retry a non-idempotent request; fixing the loop to skip that case.
